## 2. Calibration with county-cluster 95% intervals

| model | slope | slope 95% | intercept in the large | intercept 95% |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 1.030 | 0.783 to 1.299 | -0.098 | -0.330 to +0.095 |
| B | 0.881 | 0.637 to 1.144 | -0.108 | -0.350 to +0.087 |

A slope below 1 means predictions are too extreme (over-confident). Intercept in the large is the average miscalibration with slope fixed at 1.
